cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(plat C)
execute_process(COMMAND git rev-list --count HEAD OUTPUT_VARIABLE PLAT_VERSION)
add_library(plat STATIC plat.c)
if(WIN32)
    target_sources(plat PRIVATE plat_windows.c)
    target_link_libraries(plat PRIVATE ws2_32)
else()
    target_sources(plat PRIVATE plat_posix.c)
    target_link_libraries(plat PUBLIC m)
endif()
target_include_directories(plat PUBLIC include)
target_compile_definitions(plat PRIVATE PLAT_VERSION=${PLAT_VERSION})
